questions.prompt: The 100th Macy's parade finally steps off this morning — 8:30, balloons back in the sky after the storm pushed it a day. Tonight, where are you in the parade day?

options.text: Front row from the couch — up with the balloons, the whole morning.
Parade crew — group chat going, everyone rating the floats.
Catching the highlights later — the big moments will find me.
Still wiped from Thanksgiving — the parade can play to an empty room.

questions.prompt: GTA 6's got hurricanes you can unlock — a whole storm system rolling through Vice City. Tonight, you're out in it — how are you meeting the storm?

options.text: Charging straight in — the storm's the whole point.
Watching it roll in — steady, taking the whole sky in.
Chasing it with the crew — storm-chasers tonight, everyone piling in.
Too much at once — rain, wind, everywhere, I don't know where to look.

questions.prompt: Yooka-Laylee's free upgrade is here — same cozy adventure, looking better than ever — but it's skipping Xbox, so if that's your console, you're watching from the sidelines. Tonight, the upgrade's out there and you're not in it — what do you do?

options.text: Jumping platforms — I'll play it wherever it lives.
Waiting it out — it might come around eventually.
The old version's fine — happy replaying what I've got.
Gutted — free and still not for me, that stings.

questions.prompt: 'All Too Well' — ten minutes long — is back in the charts conversation, five years after the re-recording ruled the Hot 100. Tonight, one long song, nowhere to rush to — if someone handled the table while it plays, what would you want beside you?

options.text: A big mug of cocoa — slow sips, the song does the talking.
Virgin or hard — a Moscow mule hits just right tonight.
A pot of tea — refills all night, nothing rushed.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: Thanksgiving's halftime belonged to the Goo Goo Dolls — 'Iris' under the stadium lights, the whole crowd singing it back. Tonight, which sound of that moment is yours?

options.text: Full stadium roar — 'Iris' at full volume, lights and all.
Singing along with the group chat — everyone's on the chorus.
The hushed verse — the part where the whole stadium goes quiet.
Skipping the replay — I've heard it, my quiet tonight is enough.

questions.prompt: Team Cherry just put a date on Sea of Sorrow — the Silksong DLC wait finally has a shape. In the hour ahead, how does the countdown feel?

options.text: Buzzing — the date's circled and I'm counting down already.
Warming up — back in Hallownest tonight, getting ready.
Patient — it'll come when it comes, no rush.
Parking it — the wait can wait, I'm switching off tonight.
